physicalNotes: Radius 1.3162 +/- 0.023 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1794 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 915,680 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.9698 +/- 0.0328 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1794 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5631 +/- 78 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1794 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
